# Invitations

5 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/invitations` | List my pending invitations |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitations` | Invite someone to a workspace |
| GET | `/api/v1/invitations/workspace` | List a workspace's pending invitations |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitations/{id}/accept` | Accept an invitation |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/invitations/{id}` | Revoke a pending invitation |

### GET /api/v1/invitations

List my pending invitations

Returns the signed-in user's pending workspace invitations, enriched with the inviting workspace's logo and slug. Better Auth's own `listUserInvitations` joins the organization but only maps `organizationName` through, dropping `logo`/`slug` — and the invitee isn't a member yet, so the client's org list can't supply the logo either. The join here lets the user menu render the real workspace avatar instead of just an initial.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Responses**

- `200` — The user's pending invitations
  - `MyInvitationList`
    - `invitations`: array of `MyInvitation`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `organizationId`: string, required
      - `organizationName`: string, required
      - `organizationSlug`: string, required
      - `organizationLogo`: string | null, required
      - `role`: string | null, required
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/invitations

Invite someone to a workspace

Creates a Better Auth organization invitation and emails the invitee an accept link. Owner/admin only. If the invitee already has an account they also get an in-app notification.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `CreateInvitationBody`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `email`: string (email), required
  - `role`: one of `"admin"` | `"manager"` | `"member"` (default "member")

**Responses**

- `200` — The invitation was created and the email sent
  - `CreateInvitationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `invitationId`: string, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### GET /api/v1/invitations/workspace

List a workspace's pending invitations

Returns the organization's pending (not yet accepted/cancelled) invitations, oldest first. Owner/admin only — the same gate the Members settings page applies before showing them.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's pending invitations
  - `WorkspaceInvitationList`
    - `invitations`: array of `WorkspaceInvitation`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `email`: string, required
      - `role`: string | null, required
      - `expiresAt`: string, required — ISO 8601 timestamp
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/invitations/{id}/accept

Accept an invitation

Accepts one of the signed-in user's pending invitations (Better Auth creates the membership) and tells the inviter. Returns the joined workspace so the client can navigate into it. The email accept link uses the /accept-invitation/:id web route instead — that flow also has to create a fallback personal workspace and redirect.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The invitation was accepted
  - `AcceptInvitationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `organization`: object, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `name`: string, required
      - `slug`: string, required
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`

### DELETE /api/v1/invitations/{id}

Revoke a pending invitation

Cancels a pending invitation (Better Auth marks it cancelled — the accept link stops working). Owner/admin only.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The invitation was revoked
  - `RevokeInvitationResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
